run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T10:06:48Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on service frontend is explained by frontend's dependency on the ad service: Deployment ad (otel-demo) has 1 desired replica, 0 ready and 1 unavailable, and its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 cannot create the replacement pod. The kube-controller-manager rejects pod creation with the exact message 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'. ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory was created at 2026-11-17T10:05:36Z with a hard memory limit of 1503238553600m (~1433.6Mi), while the namespace's pods already request 1,993,342,976 bytes (~1901Mi), so no new pod can be admitted. The ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w was deleted at 10:05:46Z by the ReplicaSet (SuccessfulDelete / 'Stopping container ad'), the Deployment scaled down 1->0 then back to 0->1 at 10:05:56Z, and every subsequent pod creation failed on the quota; ad served its last spans around 10:07-10:08 and the ad Service has no endpoints. From that point frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds started erroring (0/s before 10:06, ~1.27 errors/s at 10:07-10:14, with its non-error status series falling to 0), together with frontend server spans GET and GET /api/data and tcp.connect errors; in 10:06-10:16 GET /api/data recorded 506.8 errored spans against only 31.5 non-error, and every other frontend operation recorded 0 errors. frontend-proxy also shows its own error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'. The ad Deployment's pod template was unchanged (revision 1; only scaling changed, generation 3), the frontend Deployment is unchanged (generation 1, revision 1, AD_ADDR=ad:8080), nodes are Ready with no memory/disk pressure, and flagd's adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc flags are 'off', so neither a rollout, node pressure nor flagd fault injection explains this. The alert rule itself is not loaded in the registered Prometheus, so its exact expression and the unit of the reported value 5.088888888888889 could not be verified.

claims.text: Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas=1, 0 ready and 0 available replicas and 1 unavailableReplicas; its status carries ReplicaFailure=True with message 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m' and Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-17T10:05:56Z.
ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad) reports replicas=0 and a ReplicaFailure condition with the identical quota rejection message, so the replacement ad pod is never created.
ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo was created at 2026-11-17T10:05:36Z with hard memory=1503238553600m and used memory=1901Mi, i.e. recorded usage already exceeds the hard limit.

The sum of active pod memory requests in namespace otel-demo was 1,993,342,976 bytes (~1901Mi) at 2026-11-17T10:16:00Z, which alone exceeds the quota's hard memory limit of ~1433.6Mi; the blocked ad container requests memory=225Mi with limit 450Mi.
The only otel-demo Deployment with unavailable replicas is ad; the other 20 deployments each report readyReplicas=1 and availableReplicas=1.

Events in namespace otel-demo show the ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w killed at 2026-11-17T10:05:46Z (Pod Killing, Normal, 'Stopping container ad'; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete), Deployment ad 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' at 10:05:46Z and 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' at 10:05:56Z, followed by 10 FailedCreate events on that ReplicaSet between 10:05:56Z and 10:11:24Z, all carrying the exceeded-quota message.

The Endpoints object ad in namespace otel-demo has no subsets, i.e. the ad Service (selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, port 8080) has no backend address; no pod of the ad Deployment exists in the namespace (20 pods listed, none named ad-*).

In the 10 minutes ending 2026-11-17T10:16:00Z frontend recorded error spans only on GET (506.77), GET /api/data (506.77), executing api route (pages) /api/data (506.77) and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (506.77), plus tcp.connect (17.84); every other frontend operation (cart, checkout, POST, other api routes) recorded 0 error spans.
For span GET /api/data in that 10-minute window frontend recorded 506.77 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans against 31.48 non-error spans, and for span GET 506.77 error spans against 4596.56 non-error spans.

frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds had a 2-minute error rate of 0/s from 09:48 through the 10:06:00 sample, then rose to 0.356/s at 10:07:00 and 1.21-1.38/s from 10:08:00 on, while its non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) series dropped from ~1.11-1.41/s to 0 by 10:14:00.

The ad service's span rate fell from a steady ~2.8-3.2/s up to 10:07:00 to 0.6/s at 10:08:00 and 0 from 10:09:00 onward, and in 10:06-10:16 its remaining spans were non-error work (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 26.23, getAdsByCategory 22.03, getRandomAds 8.39) with 0 error spans.
frontend-proxy recorded its own error spans in 10:06-10:16: span 'ingress' 520.41 and span 'router frontend egress' 516.21.

The fault originates in ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory: the only reason recorded for the ad pod being uncreatable is that quota rejection (requested 225Mi vs used 1901Mi and hard 1503238553600m), which leaves Deployment ad with 0 ready replicas and the ad Service with no endpoints while frontend's GetAds calls error.

The frontend errors are failures of the frontend->ad call path caused by the ad Service having no endpoints after the ad pod was deleted and could not be recreated: frontend emits tcp.connect error spans alongside the GetAds error spans, and the /api/data route that depends on ads fails while all other frontend routes stay at 0 errors. The exact gRPC status/detail string could not be read because no matching trace was returned and the frontend container logs were empty.

No rollout or configuration change explains the failure: Deployment frontend is at generation 1 / revision 1 with AD_ADDR=ad:8080, and Deployment ad is at template revision 1 with generation 3 (only replica-count changes), using the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad.

flagd fault-injection flags that could fail the ad service are configured off: flagd-config ConfigMap sets adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc to defaultVariant 'off', while the ad container only points FLAGD_HOST=flagd/FLAGD_PORT=8013.
All five nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False, and the ad pod's deletion is attributed to the ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete event, not to node-level pressure.

An OOMKill or kubelet eviction of the ad container is rejected as the cause: the only ad-pod event is Pod 'Killing' with reason Normal and message 'Stopping container ad' together with ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 'SuccessfulDelete' at 10:05:46Z, i.e. a controller-driven pod deletion, and no Evicted event appears in the otel-demo event set.

Raise ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory's hard memory limit, or lower container memory requests in otel-demo, so that the namespace's ~1901Mi of existing requests plus the ad pod's 225Mi request can be admitted; the quota's current hard limit of 1503238553600m (~1433.6Mi) is already below current usage.

Check the cluster audit/change history for who created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 2026-11-17T10:05:36Z and who scaled Deployment ad 1->0 at 10:05:46Z and back to 1 at 10:05:56Z, since change_history is not integrated in this Run.

gaps: change_history is not integrated, so neither the creator of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (creationTimestamp 2026-11-17T10:05:36Z) nor the actor that scaled Deployment ad 1->0->1 (10:05:46Z-10:05:56Z) can be identified.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not loaded in the registered Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and type=alert both returned no rules, so the alert expression and the unit of the reported value 5.088888888888889 are unverified. My span-based ratios do not reproduce it: frontend error share of all spans over the 10m ending 10:06:48 was 0.452%, GET error share over the 5m ending 10:06:48 was 1.18%, while GET /api/data was at 94% errors over 10:06-10:16 and GET at 9.9%.

No frontend trace was returned by Jaeger for 10:08-10:20 nor by tag error=true for 09:36-10:06, so the gRPC status/detail text of the failing GetAds calls (for example UNAVAILABLE vs connection refused) is unknown.
fetch_pod_logs returned zero lines for all windows tried on frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 (current instance), so there is no application-log evidence from the frontend.
The deleted ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its last termination reason and exit code cannot be read; no OOMKilled or Evicted evidence for it exists either way.

A cluster-wide query for networkpolicies returned no objects and no series for kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready exists in this Prometheus, so the absence of a NetworkPolicy and the kube-state-metrics ready-replica timeline could not be verified.

Impact beyond frontend and frontend-proxy error spans is not verified: no customer-facing or SLA evidence was available, and the frontend-proxy error spans were attributed only by their own span names.
next_steps: Inspect the audit log / GitOps or Helm history for ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory and for the ad Deployment scale events around 10:05:36Z-10:05:56Z.

After the quota is corrected, confirm recovery with kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="otel-demo",deployment="ad"} and traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",span_name="grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds"} returning to a zero error rate, plus a non-empty ad Endpoints object.
Review other namespaces' ResourceQuota hard limits against actual memory requests, since a hard limit below current usage blocks every new pod creation.
